object.attr: as implemented: `DEBUG` helps a person find why a call failed, and `WARNING` or `ERROR` keeps a busy client's log short. States what a level does (review Q9).
object.description: When started with `--log-level` and one of `DEBUG`, `INFO`, `WARNING` or `ERROR`, the MCP server shall write to standard error only the log messages at that log level or a more severe one.
